    "languages": ["en", "ang"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.7
  },
  {
    "operation": "cross_language_homophone",
    "chain": "Fyre → French 'feu' (fire) + 'ire' (anger); also Greek 'pyr' (fire) via sound shift f→p",

    "languages": ["fr", "grc", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.6
  },
  {
    "operation": "anagram",
    "chain": "Fyre → 'frye' (to fry, cook); also 'refy' (obsolete to refine); letters rearrange to 'ryfe' (rife, abundant)",

    "source": "generative",

    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.5
  },
  {
    "operation": "letter_symbol",
    "chain": "F (digamma, 6) + Y (Yggdrasil, axis) + R (head, Ra) + E (existence); sequence of cosmic pillars",
    "reading": "A vertical axis of being, crowned by fire, rooted in the letter of the sun.",
    "languages": ["en", "grc", "eg"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  },
  {
    "operation": "numerical",
    "chain": "F=6, Y=25, R=18, E=5; sum=54; 5+4=9; 9 = completion, initiation in cabala",
    "reading": "The number nine, a threshold of transformation, fire as the final test.",
    "languages": ["en", "he"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.45
  },
  {
    "operation": "phonetic_split",

  }
